error.bluetooth_integration_required: Bluetooth integration is required to configure this device
error.rest_server_unreachable: Cannot connect to Skelly Ultra REST server. Please ensure the server is running at the specified URL.
error.rest_server_error: REST server returned an error. Please check the server is running correctly.
error.address_required: Device address is required in manual mode

data_description.device_type: Choose the type of Halloween prop you are adding. When scanning, the type is detected automatically from the device name.
data_description.use_ble_proxy: Enable this to connect via REST server instead of direct BLE (useful for remote access or systems without BLE hardware)
data_description.mode: Choose 'scan' to discover nearby devices, or 'manual' to enter the address directly
data_description.address: MAC address of the device (required in manual mode, optional when scanning)
data_description.server_url: URL of the Skelly Ultra REST server. Required for proxy mode and live mode features (default: http://localhost:8765)

server_warning.title: REST server not running
server_warning.description: The REST server could not be reached. The integration will work for basic control, but live mode will not be available. See documentation: {docs_url}

data.acknowledged: I understand that live mode will not be available

enable_classic_bt.name: Enable classic Bluetooth
enable_classic_bt.description: Make the device expose a classic Bluetooth speaker to connect to for live mode.

play_file.name: Play file
play_file.description: Play a file from the device's internal storage by file index.

file_index.name: File index
file_index.description: The 1-based index of the file to play (must be at least 1).

stop_file.name: Stop file
stop_file.description: Stop a file that is currently playing on the device by file index.

file_index.name: File index
file_index.description: The 1-based index of the file to stop (must be at least 1).

cancel_file_transfer.name: Cancel file transfer
cancel_file_transfer.description: Cancel an ongoing file upload to the device.

send_file.name: Send file
send_file.description: Upload an audio file to the device. The file will be automatically converted to 8kHz mono MP3 format if needed. Supports local files and HTTP/HTTPS URLs, including Home Assistant media files (/media/...).

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Path to the audio file. Can be a local file path, HTTP/HTTPS URL, or Home Assistant media path (/media/...).

target_filename.name: Target filename
target_filename.description: Name to save the file as on the device (without extension). The .mp3 extension will be added automatically.

delete_file.name: Delete file
delete_file.description: Delete a file from the device's internal storage. The file can be specified either by file_index and cluster (both required), or by filename. The service will refresh the file list before and after the delete operation.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: The device registry ID of the device to target.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: An entity ID associated with the device. If provided, the device_id will be derived from this entity.

file_index.name: File index
file_index.description: The 0-based index of the file to delete. Must be used together with cluster. Mutually exclusive with filename.

cluster.name: Cluster
cluster.description: The cluster value of the file to delete. Must be used together with file_index. Mutually exclusive with filename.

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: The name of the file to delete (e.g., 'announcement.mp3'). The service will look up the corresponding file_index and cluster. Mutually exclusive with file_index and cluster.

perform.name: Perform
perform.description: Make the device say a line in live mode, with eyes, lights and movement to match a mood. The line is a literal message or written by an AI Task entity from a prompt, optionally looking at a camera snapshot.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: An entity ID associated with the device. If provided, the device_id will be derived from this entity.

message.name: Message
message.description: A literal line to say. Skips the AI. Give either message or prompt.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.description: Instructions for the AI to write the line, sent as is. The last 10 AI lines are added with a request not to repeat them. Give either message or prompt.

camera_entity.name: Camera
camera_entity.description: A camera whose snapshot is attached to the AI request. Needs a prompt.

camera_wait.name: Camera wait
camera_wait.description: With a camera, how long to wait for it to publish a new image before sending it to the AI, since snapshot cameras publish the image of what moved a moment after the motion event. 0 sends the current image right away. Only helps cameras that update their entity with each new image (such as ring-mqtt); use 0 for others.

ai_task_entity.name: AI Task entity
ai_task_entity.description: The AI Task entity that writes the line. Defaults to the preferred AI Task entity.

tts_entity.name: Text-to-speech entity
tts_entity.description: The TTS entity that speaks the line.

tts_options.name: TTS options
tts_options.description: Options for the TTS entity, such as voice.

mood.name: Mood
mood.description: auto lets the AI pick (needs a prompt), none leaves eyes, lights and movement as they are. Defaults to auto with a prompt and none with a message.

movement.name: Movement
movement.description: mood uses the mood's movement, none sends no movement, or pick the body parts to move.

restore.name: Restore eyes and lights
restore.description: Put the eyes and lights back the way they were after the line.

restore_movement.name: Restore movement
restore_movement.description: Send the previous movement setting back after the line. This makes the device move once more.

live_mode_timeout.name: Live mode timeout
live_mode_timeout.description: How long to wait for live mode to connect before failing.

wait_until_done.name: Wait until done
wait_until_done.description: Return only after the line has finished and the look is restored. When off, the action returns as soon as the line starts playing, so following actions run while the device speaks.
